core_obligations: Prove (1) through the long exact sequences (proof lines 14170-14176): let j : U -> X be the inclusion of the complement of Z; the long exact sequences for cohomology with supports on the Zariski and etale sides together with the agreements H^q(X_etale, F^a) = H^q(X, F) and H^q(U_etale, F^a) = H^q(U, F) identify the groups H^q_Z(X, F) and H^q_Z(X_etale, F^a).

Prove (2) using quasi-coherence (proof lines 14177-14186): if U is retrocompact in X, that is j is quasi-compact, then R^qj_* takes quasi-coherent modules to quasi-coherent modules and commutes with passing to the associated sheaf on the etale site; applying the triangle relating cohomology with support to the cohomology of the open complement yields that i_*H^q_Z(F^a) is quasi-coherent and equal to the associated sheaf of i_*H^q_Z(F).
proof_roadmap: Compare the long exact sequences for cohomology with supports on the Zariski and etale sides, using the agreement of the ambient cohomology.
In the retrocompact case use the quasi-coherence of the higher direct images of the open immersion and its compatibility with the associated sheaf, then apply the support triangle.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a closed subscheme Z of a scheme X and a quasi-coherent module F, the cohomology with support H^q_Z(X, F) agrees with H^q_Z(X_etale, F^a), and that when the complement of Z is retrocompact the sheaf i_*H^q_Z(F^a) is quasi-coherent and equals the associated sheaf of i_*H^q_Z(F) (statement lines 14155-14168). The proof (proof lines 14170-14187) compares the long exact sequences for cohomology with supports, using the agreement of Zariski and etale cohomology for quasi-coherent modules, and then applies the quasi-coherence of the higher direct images of a quasi-compact open immersion together with the support triangle. H2: two arguments with several independent inputs, written out in full.
